overview: The City Council approved zoning amendments for the Medford Square City Hall overlay district and passed a resolution requesting $75,000 to fund a legal defense against a federal lawsuit targeting the city's investment ordinance.

items.title: Medford Square City Hall Overlay District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Approved the zoning ordinance and map amendments for the Medford Square City Hall overlay district following recommendations from the Community Development Board. The change allows development on city-owned parking lots, though residents raised concerns regarding the proximity of replacement parking to the senior center and the potential for illegal spot zoning.

items.title: Resolution for Legal Defense Funding in Turtag v. City of Medford
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the Mayor appropriate $75,000 for the City Council’s legal defense in federal litigation challenging the values-aligned local investment ordinance. Councilors and several residents argued the city must defend its democratic process and ethical divestment goals, while opponents characterized the lawsuit as a consequence of ignoring prior legal warnings and a waste of taxpayer funds.
